description: End-to-end lifecycle management of a subscriber's cloud exchange connectivity across multiple clouds and locations, including quoting, ordering, provisioning, modification, monitoring, and teardown.

subscriber_id.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise subscriber (customer) in the connectivity platform.

service_profile_id.description: Identifier for a reusable service profile template defining technical characteristics of connectivity.

quote_id.description: Identifier for a commercial and technical quote for a requested connectivity service.

order_id.description: Identifier of a committed order derived from an accepted quote.

subscription_id.description: Identifier for an active or historical connectivity subscription instance.

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a change request against an existing subscription.

task_id.description: Identifier for a background workflow task (provisioning, rollback, retry).

endpoint_id.description: Identifier for a logical endpoint within a subscription (e.g., specific cloud on-ramp or data center port).

location_id.description: Identifier for a physical or virtual location in the cloud exchange (PoP, data center, region).

cloud_provider.description: Cloud provider identifier, e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP.

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: discover_connectivity_options
functions.description: Discover available cloud exchange connectivity options for a subscriber based on locations, clouds, bandwidth, and redundancy requirements.

account_context.description: Optional cloud account context for feasibility checks.

min_availability_sla.description: Minimum required availability SLA in percentage (e.g., 99.9).

latency_slo_ms.description: Target round-trip latency SLO in milliseconds.

functions.returns: List of feasible connectivity option bundles, including product types, locations, supported bandwidths, indicative latency, and eligibility flags.

functions.name: create_service_profile
functions.description: Create or update a reusable service profile template capturing technical and policy parameters for cloud exchange connectivity.

service_profile_id.description: If provided, an existing profile will be updated; otherwise, a new one is created.

name.description: Human-readable name for the service profile.

acl_sets.description: Optional ACL definitions applied to the connectivity.

routing_policy.description: Routing configuration for L3/Cloud Router products.

tags.description: Arbitrary key-value tags for organizing profiles.

functions.returns: Service profile metadata including service_profile_id, version, and normalized policy configuration.

functions.name: request_connectivity_quote
functions.description: Create a detailed quote for a new or modified connectivity subscription using discovered options and optional service profile.

service_profile_id.description: Optional reference to a predefined service profile; if omitted, inline parameters must be provided.

subscription_id.description: Populate when requesting a quote for modifying an existing subscription.

connectivity_design.description: High-level design to be priced if no service profile is referenced.

endpoints.description: List of endpoints participating in the service.

requested_start_date.description: Requested service start date/time in ISO 8601.

functions.returns: Quote details including quote_id, line items, recurring and non-recurring charges, validity period, and any constraints or prerequisites.

functions.name: validate_quote_feasibility
functions.description: Run technical and commercial feasibility checks on a prepared quote before order submission.

deep_validation.description: If true, triggers deep path and capacity simulation which may take longer.

checks.description: Optional subset of checks to run; defaults to all.

functions.returns: Feasibility report summarizing pass/fail per check, blocking issues, warnings, and recommended adjustments.

functions.name: submit_connectivity_order
functions.description: Submit an order based on an accepted quote, creating one or more subscriptions and provisioning workflows.

accept_terms.description: Indicates that subscriber accepted commercial and technical terms.

billing_contact.description: Billing contact details for the order.

technical_contacts.description: List of technical contacts for coordination during provisioning.

activation_preferences.description: Preferences for activation and change window.

functions.returns: Order confirmation containing order_id, initial status, created subscription_ids, and provisioning task_ids.

functions.name: get_order_status
functions.description: Retrieve detailed status and progress of a connectivity order and its associated provisioning tasks.

include.description: Additional details to include in the response.

functions.returns: Order details including status timeline, per-subscription readiness, provisioning tasks, and any blocking issues.

functions.name: get_subscription_detail
functions.description: Get technical and commercial details for a specific connectivity subscription, including endpoints and current configuration.
functions.returns: Subscription snapshot containing status, endpoints, applied service_profile, configuration fragments, and lifecycle history.

functions.name: modify_subscription
functions.description: Request a change to an existing subscription such as bandwidth upgrade/downgrade, endpoint changes, or policy updates.

requested_changes.description: Polymorphic object whose content depends on change_type.

service_profile_id.description: New profile to apply. If omitted, inline overrides must be provided.

inline_overrides.description: Policy overrides if not using a profile.

change_window.description: Preferred maintenance window for applying the change.

approval_reference.description: Internal approval or ticket reference from subscriber.

functions.returns: Change request acknowledgement including change_request_id, impact assessment summary, and any required approvals.

functions.name: check_subscription_health
functions.description: Check real-time operational health of a subscription, including SLA KPIs, alarms, and recent incidents.

time_window.description: Time window for metrics and incidents.

functions.returns: Health summary containing SLA adherence, utilization trends, active alarms, recent incidents, and recommendations.

functions.name: retry_failed_provisioning_task
functions.description: Retry a failed provisioning or change task for a subscription, with optional parameter overrides.

force_retry.description: Retry even if automatic safety checks would normally block it.

override_parameters.description: Optional parameter overrides to correct failure causes.

functions.returns: Updated task status, new attempt metadata, and any immediate validation errors preventing retry.

functions.name: rollback_subscription_change
functions.description: Initiate a rollback of a recently applied change to a subscription, restoring previous configuration where possible.

change_request_id.description: Identifier of the change request to rollback.

safe_window.description: Preferred window for performing the rollback.

functions.returns: Rollback plan and task_id representing the rollback workflow, with impact analysis and expected state after completion.

functions.name: suspend_or_resume_subscription
functions.description: Temporarily suspend or resume a connectivity subscription, optionally scheduling the action.

schedule.description: Optional schedule for executing the action.

functions.returns: Lifecycle action acknowledgement with scheduled or immediate status, and any constraints affecting the action.

functions.name: terminate_subscription
functions.description: Permanently terminate a connectivity subscription and release associated resources.

termination_effective_date.description: Requested effective date/time for termination; defaults to earliest allowed.

retain_config_snapshots.description: Whether to retain configuration history for future audits.

cleanup_cloud_artifacts.description: Controls cleanup of objects on the cloud side.

functions.returns: Termination request confirmation with effective date, any early termination charges, and deprovisioning task_ids.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import cloud exchange subscription entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many cloud exchange subscription entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many cloud exchange subscription entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_bulk_export
functions.description: Export cloud exchange subscription entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across cloud exchange subscription entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for cloud exchange subscription events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for cloud exchange subscription notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more cloud exchange subscription entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to cloud exchange subscription on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a cloud exchange subscription operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending cloud exchange subscription change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending cloud exchange subscription approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a cloud exchange subscription entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a cloud exchange subscription entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a cloud exchange subscription entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a cloud exchange subscription entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for cloud exchange subscription activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a cloud exchange subscription view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to cloud exchange subscription entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given cloud exchange subscription payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a cloud exchange subscription entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: cloud_exchange_subscription_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a cloud exchange subscription entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
